September, 2024
Author: Saurabh Shyam Shamshery

Bench: Saurabh Shyam Shamshery
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:148523
Court No. - 74
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 9258 of 2020
Applicant :- Gaurav Agarwal And 3 Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Shukla,Rahul Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pankaj Sharma,Sumati Rani Gupta
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Heard Sri Neelesh Kesarwani, Advocate holding brief of Sri Amit Shukla and Sri Rahul Kumar,
learned counsel for the applicants and Sumati Rani Gupta for the O.P. No.2.
2.

The present application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants, praying for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.6592 of 2019 (State Vs. Gaurav Agarwal And 3 Ors) under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 of I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Govindnagar,
District-Mahura, pending in the Court of C.J.M. Mahura.

entities.text: Criminal Case No.6592 of 2019 (State Vs. Gaurav Agarwal And 3 Ors)

sentences.text: 3. This is a case arising out of a matrimonial dispute.

entities.text: Gaurav Agarwal And 3 Ors. vs State Of U.P. And Anr.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This case is pending before this Court for the last four years.

5. In pursuance of an order passed by this Court, parties have appeared before learned Trial Court and their compromise has been verified which is recorded in the order dated 21.5.2024 passed by learned Trial Court.
Certified copy of the same is on record.
6. Learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 has verified the aforesaid submissions.

7. In the aforesaid circumstances, taking note of nature of allegations as well as taking note of a judgement passed by Supreme Court in State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Laxmi Narayan and Others,
(2019) 5 SCC 688, it is a fit case where the inherent powers of this Court could be exercised and accordingly the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed, however, applicants as well as opposite party no.2 will deposit Rs.2,000/- each before the District Legal Services Authority,
Mathura within a period of four weeks, in default, recovery proceedings will be initiated to recover the said amount.
